cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Supportive Rage
cards.instruction: Remain helpful and encouraging while becoming increasingly furious.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Blot the paint, don't scrub. Yes, like that. We can still save my sofa.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've stepped in it. There's paint on the carpet now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Stay exactly there. Good, you've stopped. I'll put newspaper under your feet before you redecorate my whole bloody house.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lift one foot. One, for God's sake. I'll slide my bath towel under it. You're doing fine; keep watching me.

reason: Express anger in the increasingly strained corrective instructions while A continues supplying materials and reassurance; B reports actual spread that changes the next cleanup step.
